name: Buffalo Area Transit System (BATS)
note: Primary coverage: Buffalo and Johnson County; weekly regional trips to Sheridan and Gillette counties

name: Campbell County Dial-a-Ride
note: Gillette is primary service hub; countywide service available with advance notice

name: SafeRide (Laramie)
note: Service within City of Laramie only

name: START On-Demand
note: Service within Town of Jackson only

name: Wind River Transportation Authority (WRTA)
note: Countywide service in Fremont County, includes Wind River Indian Reservation
